video_title: Draymond Green on Warriors Preseason, NBA Push-Off Rule, & LeBron's Fanatics Helicopter Deal

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green assesses the Warriors' preseason progress
quotes.excerpt: I feel a lot better going into Sacramento game than I did a week ago.
quotes.quote: We have played three preseason games thus far. We played one against the Clippers in Hawaii, versus the Lakers, and versus the Trail Blazers. A lot of us didn't play. Myself, Steph, Yaxso, BP, George Niang, Mel, the list goes on and on. We didn't play. We flew back from Hawaii, got back from Hawaii at about 2:00 AM Monday morning. We played on Tuesday at home and then played on Wednesday in Portland. For a preseason trek, the Trail Blazer game was just crazy. It's preseason. We took a different approach and didn't play in that game, but the young fellas played really well. It was great to see. I feel a lot better going into Sacramento game than I did a week ago. I feel a lot more comfortable.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the uncertainty surrounding Kristaps Porzingis' return
quotes.excerpt: No matter how many times people ask when is he coming back, I don't think that answer's changing.
quotes.quote: There has been a lot of questions about Porzingis. When is he coming back? Have you spoke to him? All of these questions. The answer is no matter how many times people ask when is he coming back, I don't think that answer's changing. When Porzingis is back, everyone will know. We will know it. I don't think it will be like, oh, he's back in a week. If you are dealing with something from a health standpoint, which none of us know, it's not like, oh, he'll be back in a week. He'll probably come back and then it'll be like, oh, y'all know he come back. Came back. Like we know he came back. I think that happens at the same time. I don't think it's necessarily a timeline of return.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green praises Brandon Podziemski as an underrated addition
quotes.excerpt: A very underrated addition is going to be B-Dubs, Brandon Podziemski.
quotes.quote: A very underrated addition is going to be B-Dubs, Brandon Podziemski. He's fast, change of pace, super athletic guard. I think he's going to be a great addition to our team. Like I said before, he can break guys down and get into the paint. I think we definitely got a little more athletic, which is good, and a little bigger, which is good as well. That will allow you to play some different type of lineups and different things like that. When you do decide to go small, you're not necessarily extremely small. Yeah, you go small, but you still got some size out there.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green defends LeBron James' use of a helicopter
quotes.excerpt: Let that man fly in peace. Y'all recording this man every time he take off and land.
quotes.quote: There has been breaking news over and over again about LeBron flying from NYC to Philly. And then now there's details out on the according to Fox Office Sports, LeBron's use of a Fanatics brand a helicopter is part of his broad deal with the company, which extends to after his playing career is over and includes use of Fanatics aviation. Only a small handful of other athletes with big Fanatics deals get same access. Thoughts on this? Well, here's my thoughts on this. Number one, let that man fly in peace. Y'all recording this man every time he take off and land and he's landing in the city and landing leaving the heli. Let that man fly in peace. Let that brother get to work how he's going to get to work and get home how he's going to get home. Must be slow news days, man. Everybody like making this man method of transportation a thing. Let that man go come and go as he please in peace.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green clarifies Rich Paul's comments on private travel
quotes.excerpt: If you remember a few weeks ago, Rich Paul said there's two players that really need to fly private.
quotes.quote: If you remember a few weeks ago, Rich Paul said there's two players that really need to fly private in the NBA. And he said that's Steph Curry and LeBron James. If you also remember a few weeks ago, he said in those guys, don't always don't don't just be paying for their flights. They have deals with people that pay for their flights. So when you see this from Front Office Sports, it should give you a little more context of what Rich Paul was saying a couple weeks ago on his podcast. There's a situation where LeBron is using this helicopter and if it's a part of his deal, you probably get a certain amount of hours. He is LeBron, so maybe he gets unlimited, who knows.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green praises Blake Hinson's selfless mindset
quotes.excerpt: This is the mindset that you must have in order to be in Blake Hinson's position.
quotes.quote: Blake Hinson, who I've had the opportunity to spend training camp with, he was with us in training camp, I think two or three years ago, I think three years ago. Great dude, man. Love Blake, incredible competitor, happy to see him carving out his role with the Jazz. But he said I can help however, man. I can go get coffee, I can maybe make a shot, I can talk to somebody, I can watch your dog. I just want to be a part of the program. And the reality is this is the mindset that you must have in order to be in Blake Hinson's position and earn your way onto a team. When you're the 14th, 15th man, possibly getting two-way deals, you have to have this mentality. You have to be willing to do whatever it is that you need to do in order to be in the position.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green reacts to the scuffle between John Collins and Dillon Brooks
quotes.excerpt: John Collins and Dillon Brooks got into a scuffle nearly five minutes into the first preseason game.
quotes.quote: John Collins and Dillon Brooks got into a scuffle nearly five minutes into the first preseason game. And considering what I said about John Collins feeling the Isaiah Stewart role, I did not know he was going to come in and try to fill the role right away. I don't think Dillon Brooks agreed with him or felt he should be filling the role either because John Collins went to choke Dillon Brooks and Dillon was like, hey, chill out. It looked like he said something of that nature like, what you doing? Yo, what you doing? Chill out. He just kind of hit his arm right down. But I respect John Collins for trying. Got to give some effort. I respect that, but the stew is arm right the way, John. You got to work on your grips, bro.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green discusses Joe Mazzulla's comments on team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: Joe Mazzulla talked about the Celtics and every team's vibes being high right now.
quotes.quote: Joe Mazzulla talked about the Celtics and every team's vibes being high right now. He said every team you lead is the most together team right now because we haven't traveled. No one's gotten benched, no one's been on a losing streak, no one's gotten blamed in the media, no one's had to go stand in the corner for 10 minutes and not get the ball. So you learn those things as the season goes on and you just learn how to work through those things together. And you can't simulate those. It just comes with time. And this is this is a fact. Like right now, everybody feel like they got a chance to make the playoffs, unless you really know like and you're realistic, but like every team feel like they can make the team they're going to make the playoffs this year.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the NBA's enforcement of the off-arm push-off rule
quotes.excerpt: NBA refs are starting to enforce the off-arm push-off rule in the preseason.
quotes.quote: NBA refs are starting to enforce the off-arm push-off rule in the preseason. And quite honestly, as a defensive player, I would tell you all, don't don't bank on this. Don't don't waste your time thinking like, oh man, like I'm going to see them calling this now. Like I'm telling you, these are the these types of rules right here that's going against the offense, they call them in the preseason and then when the season start, that shit just fade away. You know what I'm saying? Before you know it, all you great offensive players don't come down. Bam, get out of here. And shoot their shot and get their basket and everything going to go the other way. These types of rules right here in my 15 years, 15 now, they don't stand.
